description.value:
As a bonus action, you can enter a savage stance for one minute, marking one creature you can see within 10 feet of you as your prey; you gain advantage on attack rolls against it. If the marked creature drops to 0 hit points, you may spend a bonus action on a later turn to mark a new creature instead.

The stance ends early if you're incapacitated or killed. You must finish a long rest before using this feature again.
